I’m reaching out because KPMG Germany’s current focus on its public positioning around AI, reskilling, learning, and transformation really stood out to me, and your role as HR Team Lead Recruiting feels especially relevant to how talent, candidate experience, and development fit together.

I’m an M.Sc. Clinical Psychologist, and I bring an evidence-based workshop and manager-coaching lens that helps teams handle pressure without burning through people. My work is most useful in environments where fast-moving advisory environments need behavior change that is practical, measurable, and trusted by leaders.

I’d love to share how I would approach this in a KPMG Germany context if that is relevant to your current priorities.

Best,
Nitu Mann
